tools.name: Quadratic Solver
tools.description: Solves quadratic equations including complex/imaginary roots.

content.explanation: Finds roots for ax² + bx + c = 0 using the quadratic formula.

tools.name: 3x3 Matrix Determinant
tools.description: Calculates the determinant of a 3x3 matrix.

content.explanation: Computes the scalar value representing the matrix's scaling factor.
content.formula: |A| = a(ei − fh) − b(di − fg) + c(dh − eg)
content.shortNotes: A determinant of zero means the matrix is singular (not invertible).

tools.name: Pythagoras Calculator
tools.description: Calculates the unknown side of a right-angled triangle.

content.explanation: Relates the three sides of a right triangle.
content.shortNotes: Hypotenuse (c) is always the longest side.

tools.name: Trig Ratios & Inverse
tools.description: Calculates Sin, Cos, Tan and their inverses.

content.explanation: Basic trigonometric functions for angles in degrees or radians.

tools.name: SUVAT Kinematics
tools.description: Equations of motion for constant acceleration.

content.explanation: Solves for displacement, initial velocity, final velocity, acceleration, and time.
content.formula: v = u + at, s = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^2, v^2 = u^2 + 2as
content.shortNotes: Only applicable when acceleration is constant.

tools.name: Ohm's Law
tools.description: Relationship between Voltage, Current, and Resistance.

content.explanation: Calculates V, I, or R in an electrical circuit.
content.shortNotes: Valid for Ohmic conductors at constant temperature.

content.explanation: Measures the quantity of motion an object has.
Relates angles of incidence and refraction.

tools.name: Mole Concept Solver
